lines.style: Speak English as a shy, hopeful Japanese young man asking a girl on a date in the park. Say every word exactly as written: 'launch' rhymes with 'paunch' and 'haunch': lips rounded and pushed forward into a long, open 'aw' (like 'law', 'lawn'), clearly LONG, so a listener clearly hears 'Shall we have launch?' (as in launching a rocket), not 'lunch'. Slightly flat, syllable-by-syllable Japanese-style timing. Natural, not a caricature.
